mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the prior 30 days compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.1% over the prior 30 days, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in employment growth signals an overheating economy where supply constraints are outpacing labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100 and PAYEMS rises above 0.5% month-over-month, the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), a sustained increase in the core inflation rate compresses real equity valuations and triggers monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts over the prior 30 days signals strong consumer confidence and increased disposable income, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST rises by at least 0.5% over the prior 30 days, the 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment growth and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and monetary policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises above 0.5% month-over-month and UNRATE falls below 4.8%, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 2000), a sustained increase in housing starts signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST exceeds 2000, the 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
